title: SATLab at SemEval-2022 Task 4: Trying to Detect Patronizing and Condescending Language with only Character and Word N-grams
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of detecting patronizing and condescending language (PCL) using character and word n-grams and logistic regression. While PCL relates to social stereotypes and the treatment of vulnerable communities, the paper does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral frameworks.
